alerts.title: Former rebel fighters join campaign against Ebola in the DR Congo
alerts.summary: Demobilised former combatants are actively joining the fight against Ebola by participating in public information campaigns in the east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).&nbsp;

alerts.title: 900 obstacles and counting: West Bank families trapped as aid access shrinks
alerts.summary: Humanitarians continue to provide life-saving assistance to people across the Occupied Palestinian Territory despite facing obstacles such as checkpoints, instability and access restrictions, the United Nations said on Friday.&nbsp;

alerts.title: An attack on healthcare every six hours, and no one held to account
alerts.summary: Across the world, healthcare has suffered more than 10,000 attacks in the past eight years, including during the brutal conflict in Ukraine and efforts to contain the current Ebola outbreak spreading rapidly in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).&nbsp;

alerts.title: Sudan: The harrowing reality of giving birth in a war zone
alerts.summary: Sudanese women about to give birth are losing their babies and sometimes their own lives because of a lack of specialist healthcare support, amid the ongoing war, UN humanitarians said on Friday.

alerts.title: Gaza: Destruction of buildings rises by nearly 10 per cent since ceasefire
alerts.summary: New satellite assessments show the destruction of buildings in Gaza has climbed by nearly 10 per cent since October’s faltering ceasefire between Hamas and Israeli forces aim to end the two-year war, which reduced cities to rubble and displaced more than one million people, UN agencies said on Thursday.

alerts.title: Ukraine: Civilian casualties hit highest level since March 2022
alerts.summary: Civilian casualties in Ukraine reached their highest monthly level in July, with more people killed and injured than at any time since March 2022, the UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in the country, HRMMU, said in an update on Thursday.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Escalating attacks threaten peace in Yemen
alerts.summary: As tensions triggered by the US-Iran war continue to ripple across the Middle East, the Security Council held an open debate Thursday on Yemen, where escalating deadly military clashes are worsening an already fragile humanitarian situation amid fears that recent Houthi missile strikes on Saudi Arabia and commercial vessels could threaten the 2022 truce between Houthi militia and the internationally-recognised Government. UN News app users can follow our live coverage here.

alerts.title: Occupied West Bank: Settler siege of Palestinians marks a new low
alerts.summary: In the occupied West Bank, the UN human rights office, OHCHR, appealed on Thursday to Israeli authorities to help Palestinian families trapped in their homes by settlers for days, amid an intensifying campaign to seize their land.

alerts.title: Sudan: Attacks and further displacement in Blue Nile and North Kordofan
alerts.summary: The United Nations has once again urged warring parties in Sudan to protect civilians as the fighting continues to take a heavy toll on the population.

alerts.title: Deadly attack on Red Sea ship adds to global supply chain uncertainty
alerts.summary: A strike on a merchant ship off the southern coast of Yemen that reportedly killed several seafarers on Tuesday threatens to reignite deep concerns about global trade, amid the ongoing Iran-US war that has choked shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.

alerts.title: South Sudan: UN mission decries deadly attacks, works to calm tensions after ‘nothing but devastation’
alerts.summary: The UN Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS) has condemned recent armed group attacks in Warrap state which reportedly left more than 60 civilians dead and 50 others injured.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Spotlight on Israeli settler violence in West Bank
alerts.summary: The Security Council held an open debate on Tuesday which is expected to address escalating Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank as attacks on Palestinians and their property continue. UN News&nbsp;app users can follow here.

alerts.title: Myanmar: UN investigators document deliberate military attacks on civilians
alerts.summary: Myanmar's military has carried out a sustained campaign of deliberate attacks on civilians – including airstrikes on homes, schools and camps for displaced people, alongside arbitrary detention, torture and sexual violence – according to Human Rights Council-appointed investigators.

alerts.title: Fighting deepens needs and fuels further displacement in Sudan
alerts.summary: Ongoing conflict, displacement and funding shortages continue to deepen needs in Sudan, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) warned on Monday, underscoring the need for greater civilian protection.

alerts.title: Lebanon: UN peacekeepers count hundreds of Israeli strikes and incursions in a single weekend
alerts.summary: Israeli forces fired 455 projectiles into south Lebanon and breached Lebanese airspace 97 times between Friday and Sunday, the UN's peacekeeping mission in the country reported Monday – among the heaviest fire seen in months.

alerts.title: Humanitarian aid warehouses come under attack in Ukraine
alerts.summary: Russia’s ongoing full-scale invasion of Ukraine has left civilians vulnerable to repeated deadly attacks and humanitarian workers and key facilities being targeted and destroyed.

alerts.title: Sudan: ‘It made me dream again’: The students refusing to let war stop their education
alerts.summary: Sarah Tekhlu was ready to give up on university. An Eritrean refugee, she had already been displaced once from Khartoum to Madani, then again to Port Sudan, as war tore through the country around her. Higher education, she had decided, was a luxury she could no longer afford to want.

alerts.title: ‘Sudan is losing another generation’ to war, Mohammed warns
alerts.summary: More than 1,000 days of war in Sudan have left millions of children out of school, displaced or exposed to grave violations, the UN Deputy Secretary-General said on Friday, calling for renewed action to end the conflict.&nbsp;

alerts.title: ‘A clear violation’: Guterres deplores deadliest attack on Kyiv this year
alerts.summary: UN Secretary-General&nbsp;António Guterres condemned on Wednesday the deadliest Russian strikes on Kyiv this year, which killed 17 people and caused extensive damage to civilian infrastructure overnight.

alerts.title: Cuba: Independent experts condemn new US sanctions as humanitarian crisis deepens
alerts.summary: Independent UN human rights experts on Thursday condemned a fresh round of US sanctions against Cuba, calling them an attempt to force change on “a sovereign State through threats and coercion.”

alerts.title: ‘Wanton, intentional infliction of incredible pain’ by gangs in Haiti
alerts.summary: Gangs in Haiti continue to terrorise communities with the “wanton, intentional infliction of incredible pain” on people who often are just in the wrong place at the wrong time.

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Warnings of famine and collapse as South Sudan's peace deal frays
alerts.summary: Nearly eight million people in South Sudan – more than half the population – face crisis-level hunger, with famine risk now flagged in four counties, as the Security Council met this morning in New York. A cholera outbreak has killed more than 1,700 people, and some aid workers are being killed and abducted even as they try to reach those most at risk. Follow live coverage below.

alerts.title: Gaza: 300 children killed in 300 days of Israeli-Hamas ‘ceasefire’
alerts.summary: At least 300 children in Gaza have been reportedly killed in as many days since a ceasefire agreement supposedly came into effect last October to suspend military operations between Hamas fighters and the Israel Defense Forces, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Thursday.

alerts.title: Hiroshima fosters hope, 81 years on from nuclear catastrophe
alerts.summary: Eighty-one years ago on Thursday, the United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, reducing the city to ruins, killing tens of thousands of people and bringing the world “face to face with the catastrophic power of nuclear war”.

alerts.title: UN reports deadly month for Ukrainian civilians as Russian attacks intensify
alerts.summary: Russian forces hammered Ukraine with ballistic missiles and long-range drones overnight on Tuesday, killing at least 17 civilians – mainly around Kyiv – and injuring another 44,&nbsp;the UN human rights office in Ukraine reported.

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Ambassadors briefed on continuing ISIL terror threat
alerts.summary: The Security Council met on Wednesday to examine the persistent threat posed by the terrorist group ISIL, also known as Dae’sh, to international peace and security. At a conference in June, the acting head of the UN counter-terrorism office stated that Al Qaeda, Da’esh, and their affiliates “remain adaptive and resilient”.&nbsp; Moreover, they are using artificial intelligence and other emerging technologies to expand their reach, recruit and mobilise resources.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Gaza ‘unsafe for civilians’ as Israeli attacks hit homes and classrooms
alerts.summary: Gaza remains unsafe for civilians as Israeli attacks continue, including on schools and canvas classrooms, despite the October Israel-Hamas ceasefire that ended two years of war, the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) warned on Tuesday.

alerts.title: ‘A playground, a beach, a home’: UNICEF demands end to child deaths in Russia-Ukraine war
alerts.summary: As Russia’s invasion of Ukraine continues, with both sides stepping up airstrikes and drone attacks in recent weeks deep inside each other's territory, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) appealed on Tuesday for greater protection for the war’s youngest victims.

alerts.title: Strait of Hormuz disruption hits energy, fertilizer and industrial trade
alerts.summary: Disruption in the Strait of Hormuz has exposed the vulnerability of global trade to a single maritime chokepoint, with early data showing sharp falls in exports of energy, fertilizers and industrial products.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Drone strikes threaten civilians and aid operations in Sudan
alerts.summary: Drone strikes are posing deadly risks to civilians in Sudan and hampering humanitarian efforts to reach them as attacks continue to affect conflict-hit areas, the UN aid coordination office OCHA&nbsp;said on Monday.
